headword: {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}
gloss: blending of Japanese and Western styles

definitions.gloss: blending of Japanese and Western styles; Japanese-Western fusion
definitions.explanation: The combination or harmonizing of Japanese (和) and Western (洋) elements in architecture, food, fashion, or culture. A concept deeply rooted in Japan's history of cultural adaptation since the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧だ。
examples.english: This building has a Japanese-Western fusion design.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) made up of {和|わ} (Japanese), ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western), {折|せっ} (blending), and {衷|ちゅう} (middle/compromise). Used to describe anything that combines Japanese and Western elements, from architecture and interior design to food and fashion.

- {和洋折衷|わようせっちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧ (Japanese-Western style building)
